title: FACTS — what code establishes before anyone is asked
description: Deterministic: delivered or not, every check that could be made, the ending the events already decide, and the labelled facts + gaps of the evidence pack. A failed check is a hard fail — reject, and Jev is never asked (judge-compose.compose). GRADEABLE.md is the rule that turns HIRE + DELIVERY + FACTS into what Jev reads.

schema.description: which canonical entity this record is; fixed per schema

subject.x-source: what the facts are about: the job key (hs:… for a handshake subject)

delivered.x-source: judge-facts factsOf.delivered: reply digest held / JobSubmitted seen / Olas delivery

checks.x-source: judge-facts checks{}: reply_held, funded, submitted, inclusion (proof.verify.v5 DET), delivered; null = could not be checked

checks_ok.x-source: every check made passed; null = none could be made

det.x-source: the class DET that ran (proof.verify.v5 inclusion)

ending.x-source: observatory ending when the subject is a job

det_value.x-source: DET from events (jev-pad detFromEvents): completed → delivered_as_specified · rejected+submitted → delivered_with_defects · no submission → not_delivered · expired+submitted → cannot_determine

verdict_class.x-source: the seller-verdict rule on this job (trails.mjs verdictOf)

reason_on_chain.x-source: JobRejected reason (ascii) ?? the rejecting memo — what a party SAID on chain, quoted, never inferred

pair.x-source: every job between this buyer and this seller (observatory pair)

price_usdc.x-source: the price when it is in USDC (auto-complete cap check)

pack.x-source: job-evidence buildEvidence / delivery-evidence buildDeliveryEvidence: [label, value][], gaps[], the state text

anchors.x-source: the events the facts were read from; the evidence route
